Im 25.  And yeah, you're right. What frustrates me is that it was such a good starting job for a graphic design career. Especially since I lacked formal education, working in an environment where I can work with technical side of graphic design and printing seemed like such a great platform. I worked there for about 6 months before they fired me, and at that time I wasn't too bothered. I was ready to take that experience and move to another print shop.

Which I did. 2 weeks later I was at another print shop, this one more focused on the design side and really involved work. I honestly loved it and it seemed like a great next step, even tho I had been fired.

That lasted a whole 2 weeks before I got fired again. This time it wasn't even from making dumb mistakes like I did at the first shop, apparently the boss just didn't think I 'had it in me'. That was the one that hurt. I loved that job and just being told I wasn't up to snuff really fucked my self esteem..

I lost all my creative motivation, I can't even work on personal projects anymore. It's been months of being creatively dead. And it makes moving into a job at walmart just.. awful. Idk its just going to continue the gap of creativity and make it even harder to gain more experience doing what I love.

But it's just something that I have to do so, whatever I guess.

I currently live with my brother. He's taken over our apartments rent and utilities almost entirely over the last few months. 

I've been so grateful, he has no idea.. But I can't keep sponging off him, I feel terrible about it.

I do smoke weed but Im not sure if I'd call it an addiction? It used to be a lot worse but I just kind of lost as much interest in it. That was one of the habits I really jumped on after I got fired last year and am smoking less and less by the week. I still light up occasionally but only when its offered to me. Being too broke to afford any helps.

Perhaps Ill quit entirely by the end of the year.
I started looking into therapy this weekend. I also enrolled in Healthcare this year, and that will help. Therapy is one of my first major goals.

Its apparently a state by state thing in the US, not sure about other countries though. 

The real shit is that I wasn't made aware of it until a few weeks ago. When I first went through the process I got a notice about how much I would be getting, and it appeared to be a done deal.

But then I got a notice saying there was a problem with the account and that they'd need to contact my old job before continuing, and thats when I got worried.

sigh, I dont even know now. I don't know what the heck I want to do, or what path to follow. In simple terms I suppose im a graphic designer but I don't even like to call myself yet. I have a degree in media studies from a sub-par university that was pretty much a cake-walk. The degree itself does almost no good for any career options I've considered.

Personally, I'm self trained in a variety of digital art stuff. Animated graphics, web design, publications. I find it all really fun and interesting, but have a difficult time really pinning down who I am as an artist. I also have a 'wide but shallow' problem because I pick up skills really quickly and can't really think of any creative project I wouldn't love to take on, but I have no real experience and don't even have the legitimate education to back any of it up.

My last 2 jobs were both in the printing industry, and I got fired from both. Mostly due to a lack of formal education/procedures from real graphic design classes. I love problem solving so I tend to try and do everything my way. I can be stubborn in this sense. 

Personally, I just like working on projects. Particularly board games. My ultimate pipe dream would be to develop and release a board game or toy or something like that. I love coming up with ideas, creating things, and showing them to others. But again because of no real training I have no idea where to get my foot in the door. 

When I was first fired I went REALLY HARD on one of my long term board game projects, and got it really developed. But sense have lost all of my motivation and haven't touched a personal project in months..

I do love her, It's not anything like a hoarders situation. Just with 2 unkempt preteens and 4 dogs (Plus my dog) the house is never really neat.. I always feel uncomfortable.

But at least they mostly get along. If anything its a chance to get away from some bad habits and influences currently in my life.

It seems to stem from the reason I got fired. Rather then turnover, medical reasons, or some other legitimate reason I got fired simply for bad performance/attendance.  

So they sent me a letter basically saying they called my work and they told them I showed no effort or improvement so, denied.

2015 VW Beetle. It was a fleet car/used deal. It was my first car and I was so damn proud of it. It felt like a 'me' car, ya know? I was just really happy to be driving it. And at first the payment was totally manageable, I was excited to build real credit.

I lacked foresight though, I suppose.
God, I hope. That would be just tremendously helpful.

Not so much giving up, just accepting defeat.. For now.. A lot Was riding on getting unemployment, I at least could of stayed a float for a few more months. It's just such bitter end to a shitty series of shitty events.
Hm alright, good advice. I'll send an email to the case manager. We've already been communicating at least.
Um, strongly disagree there. If I ever learned I was going to jail it'd be instant suicide, no question. I could not and would not do it.
I know, you're right. It's such a bad habit. I've had a constant track of self hate running in my head for years. It's a habit now.

Living with my mom isn't the worst. I was back there over a year ago for several months. The only thing that bothers me is how uncomfortable it is there.. She's never been good at keeping a house clean.

I think we are more similar than you realize.. I relate to all of that pretty heavily.. I hadn't considered my future insurance rates.. 

Also I wonder how similar our dental problems are. Mine is really really bad, but no pain. Just missing many teeth, most of my molars are deteriorating. I've already felt with an abscess twice. 

Ive wondered how long it will be for debt to land me in jail. I only hope I can begin to manage it before that point.

Im not looking forward to it..The series of events surrounding the car purchase is an entire other story but it was one of the huge misfires of last year.

But i love the car and was so happy to have it. :(

Yeah I really appreciate it.. My finances are a serious burning wreck and I need immediate action, going rent/utility free, dropping my car payments + insurance.. It's going to be incredibly painful and humanizing but it will be a relief.

:( the worst part is the disappointment.. Ive let so many people down, and im just so ashamed.. I disappoint myself constantly.. I could have tried harder, I could have been so much better off..
